The '''Surd Nebula''' was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. [[Mala (planet)|Mala]] and the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] were just beyond the nebula's veil. The [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]] was the closest system to Surd Nebula.<ref name="Outcasts">[[Legacy (2013) 6|''Legacy'' (2013) 6]]</ref>
